page.layout: One page of text, one column. No marginal notes. Top: page number at left, Hebrew running head centred. Entries are set as hanging paragraphs, each starting with a large Hebrew root letter. Bottom left: gathering signature.

main_text.p: Plural. מְדִינוֹת Ibid. Chald. מְדִינְתָא f. Idem, Esr.5.8. Constr. מְדִינַת Dan.3.1. Plur. מְדִינָן Esr.4.15. Emph. מְדִינְתָּא Dan.2.3.
דּוּץ [?] Exsilire: Futur. תָּדוּץ Exsilit, Job.41.v.13. Chaldaicum est.

דּוּר Habitare: Infin. מְדוּר Præhabitare, Psal.84.11. דּוּרִי Habitare meum, Habitatio mea, Jesa.38.12. Chald. Particip. דָּאֲרִין Habitans, Dan.2.38. quod legendum דָּרִין: Constr. דָּארֵי Habitantes, Habitatores, Dan.4.32. legendum דָּרֵי; sic infrà in יוּץ: Futur. תְּדוּר Habitabat, Dan.4.18. יְדָרָן Habitabant, Dan.4.9. quod scribitur cum ו redundante.

דּוֹר vel דָּר m. Ætas: Generatio, Homines unâ ætate & generatione viventes, Eccles.1.4. Aff. וְאֵת דּוֹרוֹ Et generationem ejus, Jesa.53.8. Plural. לְדוֹר דּוֹרִים In generationem generationum, id est, in omnes generationes, Jes.51.8. Fœmin. דּוֹרוֹת verf.9. Aff. לְדוֹרֹתָיו Per generationes illius, Levit.25.30.
דָּר Chald. Idem: עִם דָּר וְדָר Cum generatione & generatione, Dan.3. v. ult.
דּוֹר m. Pyra, Rogus, Ezech.24.5. Kimchi in Comment. vult esse Imper. Strue pyram vel rogum, ex significatione sequentis Nominis.
מְדוֹרָה f. Pyra, Rogus, Ezech.24. v.9. Aff. מְדֹרָתָהּ Pyra ejus, Jesa.30.33.
מָדוֹר מְדוֹר masc. Chald. Habitatio: Aff. מְדוֹרָךְ Habitatio tua, Dan.4. v.22. מְדָרְהוֹן Habitatio eorum, Dan.2.11.

דּוּשׁ Trituravit: Præter. וְדָשׁ חִטִּים Et triturabat triticum, 1.Par.21.20. Infin. אֲדוּשׁ יְדוּשֶׁנּוּ Triturando triturabit eum, Jes.28.28. cum prosthesi litera א. Chald. Futurum cum Aff. וּתְדוּשְׁנֵּה Et triturabit,

page.notes: Large Hebrew root letters at the start of entries (דּוּץ, דּוּר, דּוֹר, דָּר, דּוּשׁ) are partly unclear in the scan and may be misread. Hebrew vowel points and dagesh are faint in several places, so the pointing is approximate and marked [?] where doubtful. The page ends mid-entry and continues on the next page. Printing errors such as "Jef.51.8" are left as they appear, with the long s normalised to s.
